nexthook:
THE SAME SIGNAL
KNOCKS ON A DOOR.
lines:
YOU LEFT THROUGH THE BACK.
WITH THE WATER.

AND IT COSTS YOU MORE
THAN THE DEAD EVER DID.

AN EMPTY A-ROAD, 1 AM.
FIFTY MILES AN HOUR.

SO YOU TAKE THE LONG WAY.
TWICE.

YOU SLOW. THEY SLOW.
YOU SPEED UP. SO DO THEY.

1:17 AM. LIGHTS OFF.
A JUNCTION, NO INDICATOR.

IN THE MIRROR, THEIR LIGHTS
DON'T FADE. THEY GO OUT.
AND THEY DON'T COME BACK ON.
